name: Withholding Tax Status
query:
SELECT
    wtc.name AS "Certificate:Link/Withholding Tax Certificate:150",
    wtc.purchase_invoice AS "Purchase Invoice:Link/Purchase Invoice:150",
    wtc.status AS "Status::100",
    wtc.transactionid AS "Transaction ID::150",
    wtc.certificate_number AS "Certificate Number::120",
    wtc.tax_type AS "Tax Type::100",
    wtc.tax_amount AS "Tax Amount:Currency:120",
    wtc.xml_export_status AS "Export Status::100",
    wtc.create_vat_response AS "API Response::200",
    wtc.modified AS "Last Modified:Datetime:150"
FROM
    `tabWithholding Tax Certificate` wtc
WHERE
    wtc.docstatus = 0
ORDER BY
    wtc.modified DESC
